project_type: Electron desktop app with Lit web components
verification_instructions: Run npx prettier --write . to format, verify no syntax errors with node -e require
environment_constraints: No npm install available in sandbox - use AST validation only. Lit imported from local asset file at ../../assets/lit-core-2.7.4.min.js
contribution_requirements: Prettier formatting (4-space indent, 150 print width, semicolons, single quotes). No new npm packages.
key_patterns: Lit web components with static styles/properties, views in src/components/views/, stores in src/stores/, IPC via window.require('electron').ipcRenderer, global event bus at window.cheatingDaddy.events, CSS vars for theming
directory_structure: src/components/app/ - main app shell, src/components/views/ - page views, src/components/ui/ - reusable UI components, src/stores/ - state stores, src/typing/ - typing system, src/utils/ - utilities including prompts, src/services/ - services
